entities.summary: Johan Haslund Wohlert is the bass player of Danish indie band Mew. He previously left the band on 11 April 2006, because he did not feel that he could be a rock star and a good father at the same time. He was boyfriend to Pernille Rosendahl, vocalist of the band Swan Lee, who is also the mother of his child, Tristan, who was born in May 2006.
